description: Turns rough call notes into a two-to-four sentence confirmation of what was agreed and what happens next, and flags anything the notes left unclear.

defaultPrompt: I just got off the phone with Maria about her kitchen remodel. She picked the quartz, I'll send the new number Monday. Write the confirmation.
interface.longDescription: Post-Call Confirmer turns your rough notes from a call into a short confirmation you can text or email right away: what was agreed, what happens next, and who does what by when. If your notes leave something unclear, like 'maybe Thursday,' it asks instead of guessing. It never adds a price, date, or promise that wasn't said, and it never sends anything for you. You check it and send it yourself.
interface.shortDescription: A short confirmation after every call

keywords: what we agreed on the call
name: post-call-confirmer
